# Amit Photos

> Hebrew-first photography portfolio of Amit Erez, an Israeli photographer: a categorized photo gallery, a free interactive photography school (/camera/, 24 guides, Hebrew and English), a guide to photo locations in Israel, and licensing information. Pages are available in Hebrew (default) and English.

## Photography school (interactive guides)
- [צילום שחור לבן — מה הופך תמונה לעוצמתית](https://amitphotos.com/camera/black-and-white/)
